text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer.
For making you stick around to treat my injury...
choice_data_list: Never mind that, how's the pain...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah,
please don't look so worried.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Something like this is no big deal at all.
I can treat it myself, too...
choice_data_list: I want to be of help to you.
This is part of a Trainer's job too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Something like this is no big deal at all.
I can treat it myself, too...
choice_data_list: I want to be of help to you.
This is part of a Trainer's job too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... hearing you say something so adorable,
how could I ever refuse?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Still, please don't let it weigh on your mind.
I'm sure things will get better soon...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Seeing you lose your spirit is far more painful for me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...No, the fault lies with me, doesn't it?
I'm sorry for making you worry.
I comforted the downhearted Super Creekand had her rest peacefully.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Well then, I leave it in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, having such a reliable
Trainer is wonderful too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: There, there. Good girl.

Though Super Creek laughed as if forcing herself to be cheerful,
she still seemed down.
...I tended to her while she stroked my head.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh dear... Oh my goodness, whatever shall we do?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My trainer is usually so cute,
but right now you look so grown up...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Somehow... my heart feels so warm~!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Thank you very much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Once my injury heals,
I'll work really hard on my training!

As I tend to her skillfully,
Super Creek smiles happily.
